title: Balloon Pop
tagline: Pop smiley, heart, bunny and star balloons over a sunny countryside!
howToPlay: Listen and look at the card: pop the balloons it asks for (4 blue ones, the hearts, 3 then 2 more, or one for each dot on the gold balloon) and watch the slots fill as you count. Other balloons still pop for fun. Tap the sun, a sheep, a house, a tree, the windmill or the hot-air balloon for a surprise. Choose 🎈 Free popping on the menu to pop everything.
learning: Counting to 10, colours, shapes, adding on and matching dots to quantities

title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Up to 4 rubber ducks in bumper boats grab bubbles and stars.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle your duck. Tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and BONK! In Pond helpers every duck fills one shared ten-frame together: fill the tens or find the bubbles of one colour, then count them up. 🎁 boxes make you giant, super fast or bouncy. Pick ⏱️💥 Race for the lively 90-second round. Nobody is ever out!
learning: Counting in tens (place value), sorting by colour, cooperation and spatial awareness

title: Bunny Hop
tagline: Hop Pip the bunny home through meadows, mushrooms, autumn woods and snow!
howToPlay: Tap the screen or press the space bar to hop, and tap again in the air for a flippy double hop. Carrots come in rows: hear how many, then count them as Pip munches. Logs, rocks and pumpkins come in little repeating patterns with their own notes; when a ? appears, pick what comes next. Choose 🐢 for a slower trip. At home, see all your carrot rows added up in Pip's pantry.
learning: Counting, adding rows, patterns and timing

title: Cake Stack
tagline: Stack yummy cake layers into a giant birthday cake for your animal friends!
howToPlay: Each birthday friend orders a cake in pictures, from the bottom layer to the top: listen to the order, then wait for the matching layer and tap, click or press Space to drop it when it lines up. Layers the order doesn't need yet just slide past. Later friends order patterns like strawberry, mint, strawberry, mint. Blow out the candles, then share the cake fairly: give every friend the same number of slices. Choose 🎂 Free stacking to drop any layer, or open Recipe studio to build pictured recipes and share equal slices.
learning: Sequencing, patterns, counting and equal sharing

title: Crash Racers
tagline: Race up to 4 cars through Ubud, Helsinki and Montreal. Crashes welcome!
howToPlay: 📦 Deliver: drive slowly round a picture town with four parcels. Tap a parcel to load it, find its matching house on the big map (🍎 fruit shop, 🌸 florist, 🐶 dog's house…), then drive there to hand it over. ↩️ turns you round for a shorter way. At the end, see the route you chose. 🏁 Race and 💥 Smash! are still there for lively play with friends: steer with the arrows or on-screen buttons, and 🔊 turns the sound off.
learning: Map reading, matching and route planning

title: Dragon Glide
tagline: Fly Ember the baby dragon through floating sky islands, cloud rings and rainbow waterfalls!
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to steer Ember the dragon home through four sky worlds. Each world has one goal, shown as a picture and spoken: fly through numbered rings in order (1 to 5, then 1 to 10), or gather the right hearts, stars or moons into your basket. Missed a ring? It waits for you. At each nest Ember's family sorts and counts what you brought home, and waits until you tap to fly on. Tap 🔥 to light lanterns and pop bubbles.
learning: Number order, counting to 10, sorting by colour and shape, and steering

title: Fish Pond
tagline: Go fishing with Bear and fill your book with fish, a puffer, a whale and treasure!
howToPlay: Pick a place: sunny lake, sunset river, starry night, icy sea or coral reef. Tap the water (or press Space) to cast. When the bobber dips and a big ! pops up, tap anywhere to reel it in. Missed one? It just swims off giggling and another comes along. Every catch goes into your 📖 book: can you find all 15? After a catch, tap the glowing spot to look closer and hear a true fact.
learning: Observation, animal habitats (fresh water and sea) and counting

title: Memory Match
tagline: Flip the cards and find the matching animal twins!
howToPlay: Tap two cards to turn them over and hear each animal's name. Find all the matching pairs! Choose how they match: 🐶🐶 twins, 🐮🔊 an animal and its sound (listen carefully, the speaker card only makes the noise), or 🐮 and its baby (a cow's baby is a calf). Tap 👀 once a round to peek at a pair. Start with 2 pairs and grow up to 10.
learning: Visual and auditory memory, animal names and baby animal words

title: Paint Splash
tagline: Roll giant paint rollers with up to 4 friends and paint a picture together!
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to roll your animal's paint roller. Tap the 🔴🟡🔵 pots to change your paint. Roll a new colour over wet, shiny paint to mix it: red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, red and blue make purple. Grab a 🪣 bucket for a big splash. There is no clock: tap 🖼️ Finished! when your picture is done (and when the playground is nearly all painted, we'll ask), then see the colours you discovered together. It is kept in My pictures by itself. Choose ⏱️ Quick for a 75-second round with 🌈 rainbow and 💧 water puddles. Open Mix my colours to explore the same red/yellow/blue toy paint model in the colour studio.
learning: Colour exploration, creative patterns and cooperation

title: Penguin Bowling
tagline: Belly-slide a chubby penguin down the ice and knock over snowmen and fish!
howToPlay: Swipe up (or pull back and let go) to slide the penguin down the ice. A curvy swipe makes it curve! On a keyboard, ← → aim and Space slides; ◀ ▶ move the penguin. Bumpers 🛟 keep the penguin out of the gutters. After every roll, count the pins still standing: fallen and standing always make 10. Before a second roll, find where the pins are left, then aim for them. Tap 💭 to guess how many will fall first.
learning: Number bonds to 10, counting, predictions and spatial reasoning

title: Rocket Garage
tagline: Snap together a silly rocket, then blast your animal pilot off to the Moon and beyond!
howToPlay: Tap or drag parts from the tray to build your rocket: nose cones, windows, fuel tanks, fins, boosters and stickers (tap the rocket to swap a part, tap a colour to paint it). Press the big red button to launch! When you change a part, guess first: will it go farther, the same, or less far? Watch last time's rocket fly beside yours, then hear what your change did. Every discovery goes into your 📓 notebook. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to steer and catch stars in fives. Every new planet you visit unlocks new parts, and the 🧪 workshop races rocket A against rocket B.

title: Star Catcher
tagline: Fly Kitty’s rocket past friendly planets and catch the falling stars!
howToPlay: Drag your finger or mouse, or use the arrow keys, to fly Kitty's rocket. Every star you catch lights one star of a real constellation: build Cassiopeia, the Southern Cross, Orion, the Little Dipper and the Big Dipper, one at each planet, and hear each one's name and a true fact. Gems add a little twinkle and a magnet pulls stars in. Sleepy space rocks just make you dizzy. After five constellations, fly home to see your whole night sky.
learning: Counting, real constellations and star patterns
